fields.name: Haridāsa dāsa (Haribol Kuṭīra, Navadvīpa; author of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.aka: Haridāsa Dāsa (Śrīdhāma Navadvīpa, Haribola-kuṭīr), Harendra Kumāra Cakravartī (birth name)
fields.appearance: September 1898, at Mahugrāma (Pheni, Noakhali) (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Mahugrāma (Pheni, Noakhali); Comilla (teacher); Navadvīpa (Haribol Kuṭīra); Vṛndāvana (Govinda-kuṇḍa)
fields.guru: Harimohana Śiromaṇi Prabhu (dīkṣā); Giridhārī «Haribol» Sādhu of the Haribol Kuṭīra (veśa); Manohara dāsa Bābājī (who ordered him to search for the lost Gauḍīya books)
fields.works: Śrī Śrī Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Jīvanī; editions of some forty Gauḍīya works (Kṛṣṇa-līlā-stava, Camatkāra-candrikā, Siddhānta-darpaṇa, Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu…)
fields.notes: Born Harendra Kumāra Cakravartī (1898), son of Gaganacandra Tarkaratna; M.A. in Sanskrit with a gold medal. Took veśa from Giridhārī Haribol Sādhu (#2145) and lived at the Haribol Kuṭīra; by Manohara dāsa Bābājī's order spent his life finding and publishing lost Gauḍīya books; author of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna. His brother Maṇīndrakumāra was Mukunda dāsa Bābājī.

fields.disappearance: 1911, in Vṛndāvana (record of Mādhava dāsa Bābājī)
fields.place: Born at Śāntipura; Burma (court paṇḍita); Vṛndāvana (Keśī-ghāṭa; bhajana-kuṭīra and samādhi at Keyārī-vana)
fields.guru: Madana-gopāla Gosvāmī (Bhāgavatam); of Advaita's family (son of Rāmacandra Gosvāmī)
fields.disciples: Mādhava dāsa Bābājī (śikṣā); Saccidānanda Vrajabālā (worship as a gopī)
fields.works: Rahasyārtha-prakāśikā (on Rūpa Gosvāmī's Nikuñja-rahasya-stava); Bengali Kṛṣṇa-bhāvanāmṛta, Camatkāra-candrikā, Saṅkalpa-kalpadruma; Stava; Gītāvalī
fields.notes: Son of Rāmacandra Gosvāmī, tenth in Advaita's line; court paṇḍita of the King of Burma; settled in Vṛndāvana (Keśī-ghāṭa) from 1891, a great teacher of the Bhāgavatam; took sannyāsa at 56; died 1911. Viśvanātha Cakravartī once accepted his hospitality (his seat is worshipped at Keśī-ghāṭa).

fields.name: Mādhava dāsa Bābājī (Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa)
fields.place: Born at Baradhariyā near Rāmakeli (Māldaha); Vṛndāvana (Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa; Gopīnātha Bāgh, «Siddha-pīṭha»); Kāmyavana; Varṣāṇā
fields.guru: Premānanda Gosvāmī of Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa (veśa and dīkṣā); Rādhikānātha Gosvāmī (śikṣā)
fields.disciples: Rāmadāsa Bābājī (who took him as his guru); Kṛṣṇānanda Svāmī
fields.notes: Born 1857 at Baradhariyā near Rāmakeli; at 27 left for Vṛndāvana and took shelter of Premānanda Gosvāmī of Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa; lived with Jagadānanda and Dharma dāsa Bābājī, mahānta of Siddha Bābā's monastery at Kāmyavana; śikṣā-disciple of Rādhikānātha Gosvāmī; friend of Rājarṣi Vanamālī Rāya and of the Rājā of Munger. Died 1933.

fields.disappearance: 1896, the third day after the full moon (the record's text)
fields.place: Vṛndāvana (Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa, the seat of Nityānanda's family)
fields.guru: His elder brother Nṛsiṁhānanda Prabhu (dīkṣā); a Vaiṣṇava of the Madana-mohana temple, who changed his life
fields.notes:
Second son of Pūrṇānanda Gosvāmī of Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa (Nityānanda's family); dīkṣā from his elder brother Nṛsiṁhānanda. After a wayward youth he became a model of humility and service to the Vaiṣṇavas, with disciples from Bengal to Kabul. Died 1896.

The record also held Premānanda Bhāratī and a Premānanda brother of Nityānanda, now in their own records (07-11-2026).
